moments.title: Madonna turns 68
moments.blurb: The undisputed Queen of Pop, Madonna Louise Ciccone, celebrates her 68th birthday today, continuing her reign as one of music's most influential artists.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to the one and only Madonna! Still reinventing, still iconic, still the Queen of Pop. What's your ultimate Madonna track?

angles.name: Madonna's influence
angles.copy: From 'Like A Virgin' to 'Vogue', Madonna turns 68 today. Her impact on music, fashion and culture is undeniable. What's her most groundbreaking moment for you?

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day

source.l: The Hundred Official Site / Radio Times

angles.copy: It's Finals Day in The Hundred! Who are you backing to lift the trophy at Lord's today? Two huge games of 100-ball cricket ahead!

moments.title: Green Man Festival Kicks Off

angles.copy: From music to comedy, science to wellness, Green Man Festival returns to the stunning Brecon Beacons from Thursday. Get ready for four days of magic!
